issue_title: [Bug] save 方法中 os.fdopen 与 fchmod 顺序可能导致权限设置后、写入前文件描述符泄露
fix_summary: Added finally block to close file descriptor when fchmod fails after mkstemp

changes: Added `fd = None` after fdopen to mark ownership transfer
Added finally block to close fd if not taken by fdopen

risks: Minimal risk: The finally block uses contextlib.suppress(OSError) to handle any close errors gracefully
